In the outer ring (Ambiguity 1), the "Deceived" category accounts for 67.6%, the "Partially" category for 57.9%, and the "Not Deceived" category for 10.5%. In the inner ring (Ambiguity 2), the "Deceived" category accounts for 31.6%, the "Partially" category for 23.5%, and the "Not Deceived" category for 8.8%. The percentages are explicitly labeled within each segment of the donut chart. A legend is provided on the right side of the image, with two separate boxes corresponding to the outer and inner rings, each listing the three categories and their respective colors. The segments are arranged in a clockwise direction, with the largest segment (Deceived in Ambiguity 1) positioned at the top left and the smallest (Not Deceived in Ambiguity 2) at the bottom right.
